requirement: Add a Start Over button for NYT Connections without deleting statistics or preferences.

architecture.decision: Add a dedicated connections-current reset strategy that removes only the verified anonymous daily-state key games-state-connections/ANON and reloads the embedded frame.
architecture.evidence: The current public NYT Connections bundle builds daily state keys as games-state-<game>/<user or ANON>; Connections uses game=connections. Settings and stats are separate.
architecture.safety: Do not clear all nytimes.com storage, settings, display preferences, or statistics.
